senses.gloss: भङ्क्तृ भङ्क्तृ, i. e. भञ्ज् + तृ, m., f. त्री, and n. Breaking, one who breaks down, Man. 9, 289.

भङ्ग भङ्ग, i. e. भञ्ज् + अ,
 I. m.
 1. Breaking, Pañc. iii. d. 16.
 2. A fissure, a broken piece, Vikr. d. 107 (a branch).
 3. Interruption, Pañc. 8, 19; obstacle, Vikr. 12, 17.
 4. Repudiation.
 5. Defeat, discomfiture, destruction, Hit. 100, 3; ruin, Lass. 76, 18.
 6. Disappointment, neglect, Hit. ii. d. 52.
 7. Fear, Pañc. 219, 18; iv. d. 43.
 8. Curving, Śāk. d. 7; [] knitting (the brow), Utt. Rāmac. 138, 3.
 9. Fraud.
 10. A wave.
 11. A water-course.
 12. Disease.
 II. f. गा Hemp.
 --Comp.

भङ्गि and भङ्गी भङ्गी, i. e. भञ्ज् + अ + इ, f.
 1. Fracture.
 2. Separation, interval, Lass. 83, 1; step, degree, Ragh. 13, 69.
 3. Incurvation, Lass. 87, 16.
 4. Current, Rājat. 2, 131.
 5. figurat. Modesty, Kathās. 21, 103.
 6. Fraud, pretext, Kathās. 3, 53.
 7. A wave, Ragh. 16, 36.
 --Comp.
भङ्गिन् भङ्गिन्, i. e. भङ्ग + इन्, adj., f. नी, Frail, perishable, Lass. 42, 18; Bhartṛ. 2, 88 (क्षण-, in a moment; v., and better r.).

भङ्गुर भङ्गुर, i. e. भञ्ज् + उर,
 I. adj.
 1. Crooked, Bhartṛ. 3, 36.
 2. Frail, perishable, Pañc. 165, 17; vanishing, Hit. i. d. 186, M.M.
 3. Fraudulent, Lass. 84, 9.
 II. m. The [] bend of a river.
 --Comp.
भङ्ग्य भङ्ग्य, i. e. भङ्गा + य, n. A field of hemp.
भङ्ग- + भय भङ्ग- + भय, Pañc. i. d. 357 (भङ्गभयाद् दिवः, from fear that (else) heaven would break down).
भाङ्गासुरि भाङ्गासुरि, m. A proper name, Nal. 19, 11.
भाङ्गीन भाङ्गीन, i. e. भङ्गा + ईन, n. A field of hemp.
भङ्ग- + सार्थ भङ्ग- + सार्थ, adj. fraudulent.
